move: screen rises into 3D pose, stat cards fly in, scrolls, flies off
how: Four beats on a dark stage with perspective:1600px. 1) A masked title line rises (yPercent:110, expo.out) and a .cam wrapper carrying an 820x520 browser window comes up from y:520/rotateX:30/rotateY:-14/scale:0.9 to y:70/rotateX:14/rotateY:-12/scale:0.84 (expo.out) over 5%-21%, then nav, headline lines, copy and a gradient art block reveal inside. 2) At 29% the camera swings to rotateY:10/rotateX:8 (power3.inOut, 2s) while the title fades up and three white stat cards fly in from x:-300/rotateY:40, x:300/rotateY:-40 and y:200 (expo.out), their progress bars scaleX from 0 and avatars pop with back.out(2). 3) At 49%-73% the inner .doc scrolls y to -(scrollHeight - viewport) (power2.inOut) as feature cards and a CTA band rise into place; the floats drift opposite ways on sine.inOut and the camera counter-rotates gently. 4) At 78% the screen tilts to rotateX:40 and flies to y:-700 with expo.in, floats lift away, and an end card with a logo dot (scale 0/rotate -90, back.out(2)) fades in, then fades out at 96%.
adapt: Replace the promo title/subtitle, the site content inside the window (brand, headline, feature cards, band), the three stat cards and the end-card name/tagline; keep the four-beat structure and camera poses (rotateX/rotateY values), the 2.2s scroll and the expo.in fly-off. Colours live in .cta/.band/.art gradients.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the .cam wrapper, window, floats and end card inside el (el must have perspective and transform-style set); animate(el, shot, D) measures scrollHeight, builds the same timeline with beats at 0.05, 0.29, 0.49 and 0.78 of D and returns it. autoAlpha on .end and gsap.set must be scoped to el; the 3D transforms need the parent to keep perspective.
caveats: 9s effect with four distinct beats, longer than most
relies on parent perspective:1600px and transform-style:preserve-3d
scroll distance measured at build time from layout
multiple large box-shadows on 3D-rotated cards are paint heavy
